{{Quote|Several dozen militia members and colonists took the captured ships to Affavan, where the slaves from Parcovey Minor were to be sorted and auctioned off, or disposed of at a parlay-feast between clans Utoradii and Vijilakii. Instead of terrified slaves, the assembled Hutts found themselves face to face with Belasco Volunteers who were heavily armed and seeking vengeance.|Thunys Albegron, Proceedings of the Obroa-Skai Conference on Popular Entertainment|<ref name="Zenith of the Republic">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-5-zenith-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 5: Zenith of the Republic}}</ref>}}
'''Affavan''' was a smoggy [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] that lay on the [[Hollastin Run/Legends|Hollastin Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. During the [[Kymoodon Era]], it was the site of a retaliatory attack by the [[Belasco Free Volunteers]] [[Militia/Legends|militia]] on the [[Utoradii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] after the latter's forces attempted a [[Assault on Parcovey Minor|raid]] on the planet [[Parcovey Minor]]. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, Affavan was featured in the [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] series ''[[True Tales of the Ancient Republic]]'', which depicted a fictionalized version of the raid and its aftermath.

==Description==
Affavan was a smoggy [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Affavan system/Legends|Affavan system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Hollastin Run/Legends|Hollastin Run]], which connected it to the worlds of [[Circumtore/Legends|Circumtore]] and [[Hollastin]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|It would have been a cruel revelation for the boys and girls of a century ago to learn that the intrepid Sector Ranger Novan Nune almost certainly never existed&mdash;much less followed the colonists kidnapped on Parcovey Minor to the dreaded arenas of Affavan, deep in Hutt Space, fought as a gladiator to win their freedom, and then returned to destroy the Hutt kajidic that had ravaged their world.|Thunys Albegron, Proceedings of the [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-Skai]] Conference on Popular Entertainment|<ref name="Zenith of the Republic" />}}
At some point during the [[Kymoodon Era]],<ref name="Zenith of the Republic" /> which lasted from the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] to [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], specifically those belonging to the [[Utoradii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] clan, planned to [[Assault on Parcovey Minor|raid]] the world of [[Parcovey Minor]] and transport captured colonists to Affavan, where they would be either sorted and auctioned off as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] or [[Death/Legends|killed]] at a parlay-feast that the Utoradii were having together with the [[Vijilakii]] kajidic. However, unbeknownst to the Hutts, their forces on Parcovey Minor had been routed and their [[Starship/Legends|starships]] captured by the [[Belasco Free Volunteers]] [[Militia/Legends|militia]]. The [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]] Volunteers sent several dozen heavily armed [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and colonists aboard the Hutt starships to Affavan, where they surprised and attacked the Hutts. The actions of Belasco Volunteers on Parcovey Minor and Affavan were recorded in a [[Belascoan Archive Report|report]] that came to rest in a [[Kymoodon-era government archive|government archive]] on the planet Belasco.<ref name="Zenith of the Republic" />

In [[114 BBY]], [[Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim]], an installment of the [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] series ''[[True Tales of the Ancient Republic]]'', was released, which depicted a fictionalized version of the raid on Parcovey Minor. In the holodrama, which was set in the final [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of the Kymoodon Era, the Hutt attack on the colony was successful, and the enslaved settlers were brought to Affavan. Instead of the Belascoan militia, however, they were followed to the Hutt planet by the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Ranger]] [[Novan Nune]], who fought as a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] in Affavan's arenas to secure the colonists' release and afterward returned to Parcovey Minor in order to defeat the Hutt kajidic responsible for the raid.<ref name="Zenith of the Republic" />

[[5 ABY/Legends|One-hundred-and-nineteen years]] after the release of the holodrama, the fragmentary remains of the Belascoan archive report were discovered. This allowed [[Academician of Popular Studies]] [[Thunys Albegron]] to [[Proceedings of the Obroa-Skai Conference on Popular Entertainment|remark]] on the differences and the similarities between the historical and fictionalized versions of the events on Parcovey Minor and Affavan during the [[Obroa-Skai Conference on Popular Entertainment]] in the year [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="Zenith of the Republic" />

==Inhabitants==
Affavan was a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] world that was considered seedy, and it was frequented by Hutt servant species as well as members of the [[t'landa Til]] species. Hutts could also be seen on the planet, though they usually represented the lowly [[H'uun]] caste or the [[Shell Hutts|Shell Hutt]] clan.<ref name="TEA" /> Affavan lay within the Shell Hutts' sphere of influence.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Others were meant to sound like they were named by other species &ndash; Affavan and Ulmatra, for instance.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Suvudu">{{Suvudu|url=2009/08/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-mapping-hutt-space.html|text=STAR WARS: THE ESSENTIAL ATLAS &ndash; Mapping Hutt Space}}</ref>}}
Affavan was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square S-12.<ref name="TEA" /> In a 2009 article published on [[Unbound Worlds|Suvudu]], Fry noted that the name of Affavan was intended to sound as if it had been named by a species other than the Hutts.<ref name="Suvudu" />
